Z Purton stated that approaching the first turn COURIER MAGIC got its head up and commenced to race fiercely.  He said for some distance thereafter COURIER MAGIC was checked to avoid runners in front and as a result became badly unbalanced and shifted out abruptly approaching the 1300 Metres.  He added that he was also concerned with his mount’s action.  Trainer K L Man stated that, in his view, the blinkers being reapplied to the horse caused it to race fiercely.  He added that he had been pleased with COURIER MAGIC leading into today’s race and had expected it to run well.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of COURIER MAGIC were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, COURIER MAGIC will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial from an inside barrier in amongst other horses and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 1300 Metres was steadied to avoid MEEPMEEP.
No report.
Shortly after the start was bumped by SUPER PACE which lay out.  In the early stages raced keenly.

Jumped awkwardly.  Near the 1300 Metres was checked to avoid COURIER MAGIC when that runner shifted out abruptly.  J McDonald stated that after settling back in the field his mount was disappointing in its failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between ATOMIC BEAUTY and BEAUTY MISSILE which shifted out after being crossed by SMART TRIO.  H Bentley could offer no explanation for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Lay out shortly after the start and made contact with TURF PHOENIX.  Apprentice E C W Wong stated that his instructions were to go forward.  He said despite riding his mount along in the early stages it did not show sufficient pace to do so.  He said after being crossed by TURF PHOENIX in the early stages SUPER PACE raced keenly and did not settle for some distance thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out at the start and made contact with KING ALLOY.  Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, COLOURFUL WINNER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Made contact with a rail entering the racecourse and then became unbalanced when entering the All Weather Track.  Was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.   From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 800 Metres was eased when crowded between GLORY CLOUD and YEE CHEONG RAIDER which shifted out slightly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running behind COLOURFUL WINNER.  After improving into a tight run between COLOURFUL WINNER and GLORY CLOUD leaving the 200 Metres then could not be fully tested until passing the 100 Metres when it shifted to the outside of GLORY CLOUD.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between GLORY CLOUD and WINNING MACHINE.
Bumped at the start.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

C L Chau reported that his mount was not comfortable racing amongst other horses during the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Hampered near the 600 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Making the turns in the middle stages hung out and near the 600 Metres shifted out, resulting in EMBRACE ABERDEEN being hampered.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of M Guyon, 4th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.

When questioned C Y Ho stated that the intention was to hold an on-pace position but as the start was effected his mount bounded and as a consequence lost ground and settled further back in the field than intended.  He added after following DIRIYA during the race he shifted to that runner’s outside with a view to improving behind AUTUMN VIBES.  He said when AUTUMN VIBES then commenced to give ground near the 350 Metres he became held up behind that runner and as a consequence did not obtain clear running until near the 150 Metres when he shifted to the outside of BROWNNEEDSFURTHER.
Jumped awkwardly.
No report.

Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Leaving the 1000 Metres raced keenly when racing tight between EMBRACE ABERDEEN and LITTLE MONSTER.  Near the 600 Metres was steadied away from EMBRACE ABERDEEN.  A Atzeni reported that on jumping his mount made contact with the right side of its starting gate and as a consequence lost ground.  He said as a result he was unable to hold a forward position as he was instructed.  He added that AUTUMN VIBES was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  The performance of AUTUMN VIBES was considered disappointing as compared to its most recent starts.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTUMN VIBES will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 850 Metres SUPERB GUY (A Atzeni) shifted in, resulting in JUBILANT WINNER being taken in onto SALUTE KING PRAWN which then shifted in and away from JUBILANT WINNER, crowding the running of TOP PEAK which became unbalanced.  A Atzeni was reprimanded.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

On jumping was bumped by KYRUS TREASURE which shifted in.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SUPERB GUY.  C L Chau reported that passing the 50 Metres his whip was knocked from his grasp by the whip of R Kingscote, rider of FORTUNE KINGO.
Near the 850 Metres was checked to avoid TOP PEAK.  Between the 450 Metres and the 200 Metres was badly held up for clear running.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Lay in in the early stages of the Home Straight and proved difficult to ride.  Between the 250 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running when being shifted to the outside of FLYING KNIGHT.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped at the start.  B Avdulla stated that he was given the option of holding a more forward position and after commencing well he was able to comply with his instructions albeit he had to make some of his mount to do so.  He added in the Home Straight when runners improved to his outside JUBILANT WINNER commenced to give ground and did not finish the race off thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Fractious in the starting gates, was removed from the starting gates and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse was suitable to race.  The barrier manners of SALUTE KING PRAWN were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SALUTE KING PRAWN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.  Near the 850 Metres shifted in and away from JUBILANT WINNER despite the efforts of its rider and became unbalanced.

After the 1100 Metres commenced to race keenly and shifted out when being steadied away from CITY THUNDER.  When giving ground near the 250 Metres lay out and was steadied away from FLYING KNIGHT when that runner shifted in slightly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the 1100 Metres was eased to avoid WUKONG JEWELLERY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M Guyon reported that his mount would not respond to his efforts to restrain in the early stages and made the first turn wider before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners and performance of GOOD FORTUNE, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GOOD FORTUNE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 500 Metres was steadied to avoid BETTER AND BETTER.  Near the 400 Metres blundered when being briefly held up behind BETTER AND BETTER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Shortly afterwards was then hampered when crowded by STAR ELEGANCE which was taken in by RELIABLE DAD.  Sent for sampling post-race.
M L Yeung reported that the intention was to hold a forward position.  He said when POSITIVE SMILE jumped only fairly it settled further back in the field than instructed.
Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start shifted in and made contact with WINNING DATA.

Despite being ridden along in the early stages did now show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.

L Ferraris reported that his mount hung out under pressure in the Home Straight when it was giving ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted out at the start and lost ground.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

On jumping made contact with the left side of its starting gate and lost ground.  L Hewitson stated that whilst he was given the option of riding the horse in a more conservative manner today, when it jumped awkwardly, he was obliged to settle in a midfield position.  He added in the Home Straight his mount did not run on and had recommended for the reapplication of blinkers for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

M F Poon reported that over the concluding stages he became concerned with the horse’s action and as a result he eased it down.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FLYING TING LOK was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING TING LOK will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

The barrier manners of CALL ME GLORIOUS were considered unacceptable. Jumped awkwardly.  Y L Chung (STAR SATYR) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 1000 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of LOCH TAY, resulting in LOCH TAY striking the heels of STAR SATYR and blundering badly.  Y L Chung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 27 December 2025 and to expire on Friday, 2 January 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  R Kingscote stated that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.  For some distance approaching the 1200 Metres raced tight between NEVER PETER OUT and LOCH TAY.  Near the 700 Metres was checked to avoid WIN EASE.
No report.

Y L Chung pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 1000 Metres (see LOCH TAY) and also pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 700 Metres (see WIN EASE).  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  <10/12/2025 Appeal – Jockey Y L Chung > Jockey Y L Chung has lodged a notice of appeal against the decision of the Racing Stewards to impose the penalties for two charges of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] when he rode STAR SATYR in Race 9 at the Sha Tin race meeting held on 7 December 2025. Jockey Chung is appealing against the decision of the Racing Stewards and the severity of the penalties. <18/12/2025 Appeal – Jockey Y L Chung > The Appeal Panel has granted leave for Jockey Y L Chung to amend his notice of appeal originally against the decision of the Racing Stewards and the severity of the penalties imposed on 7 December 2025 to be only against the severity of the penalties.  Leave has also been granted by the Appeal Panel for the penalties to be suspended pending the determination of the appeal. <30/12/2025 Result of Appeal Hearing – Jockey Y L Chung > The Appeal lodged by Jockey Y L Chung against the severity of the penalties imposed by the Racing Stewards for two charges of careless riding under Rule 100(1) arising from his ride on STAR SATYR in Race 9 at the Sha Tin race meeting held on 7 December 2025 was heard by the Appeal Panel at 2:30 p.m. on 29 December 2025.  The original penalties were: (a) Charge 1:  Suspension from riding in races for two Hong Kong race days commencing on 27 December 2025 and expiring on 2 January 2026, after pleading guilty to careless riding approaching the 1000M; and (b) Charge 2: Suspension from riding in races for two Hong Kong race days commencing from 21 January 2026 and expiring on 26 January 2025, after pleading guilty to careless riding near the 700M. The Appeal Panel carefully considered the films of the relevant incidents, the transcript of the Racing Stewards’ inquiry, the evidence taken in this Appeal, and the submissions made by the parties.The Appeal Panel partly allowed the appeal by reducing the penalty of Charge 2 from two Hong Kong race days to one Hong Kong race day. The suspensions for the two charges are to be served consecutively. Accordingly, Jockey Chung is suspended from riding in races as follows:- (a) Charge 1: Two Hong Kong race days, commencing from 18 January 2026 and expiring on 22 January 2026; and (b) Charge 2: One Hong Kong race day on 25 January 2026.

Bumped on jumping.  Y L Chung (STAR SATYR) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 700 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of WIN EASE, resulting in WIN EASE having to be checked and losing its rightful running.  Y L Chung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 21 January 2026 and to expire on Monday, 26 January 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, WIN EASE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Prior to the start being effected became fractious in the starting gates, resulting in the hood and bridle being displaced when the starting gate handler was endeavouring to assist the horse.  As the Stewards were satisfied that the horse’s gear had been displaced prior to the start being effected and this had prejudiced the horse’s ability to jump and its chances in the race, the horse was declared a non-runner.  As a result VERMILION TEMPEST raced throughout the event with its rider Apprentice E C W Wong having limited control when the bridle remained displaced.
Shifted in near the 1100 Metres and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 700 Metres was bumped by ETALON OR.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Crowded shortly after the start.  In the middle stages raced keenly and leaving the 700 Metres shifted out and made contact with TOP DRAGON when being steadied away from FORZA TORO.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. M Guyon  was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height near the 300 Metres.
Shortly after the start was bumped and became unbalanced.  Over the final 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running and as a result could not be fully ridden out to the finish of the race.

Bumped at the start.  Near the 1100 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by LITTLE PARADISE which shifted in slightly. A Atzeni was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height near the 300 Metres.

Bumped at the start.  For some distance after the 450 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when positioned behind GUMMY GUMMY.  Over the final 50 Metres could not be fully ridden out when held up between GHORGAN and BUCEPHALAS.

Shifted out at the start and made contact with LUCKY SAM GOR.  J Orman stated that from a wide barrier he was asked to take up a handy position but after commencing well as KA YING ATTACK was positioned wide he elected to go forward and lead to avoid racing wide.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed the instructions and stated that he issued those instructions as he was of the view that there was less pace in this race as compared to the horse’s first up run on 26 October 2025.

Jumped awkwardly and then was crowded shortly after the start.  After travelling a short distance was bumped by ETALON OR which shifted in and away from LITTLE PARADISE.  Approaching the 1000 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of GRATIFIDE which was racing tight to the inside of TOP DRAGON.

Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with ETALON OR.  When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight R Kingscote stated that soon after entering the Home Straight he was mindful of ETALON OR being positioned to his inside and in advance of him looking to shift out.  He said once ETALON OR had cleared him near the 300 Metres he then had GUMMY GUMMY improve to his inside and made contact with GRATIFIDE as GUMMY GUMMY endeavoured to shift out.  He said as a consequence between the 300 Metres and the 100 Metres he did not use the whip on the horse and when he was satisfied that GRATIFIDE was giving its best during this section of the race he did not see it necessary to increase his vigour.  He added that when he was satisfied he was not in a position to interfere with GUMMY GUMMY he was able to apply more vigour to the horse, particularly over the concluding stages.  The Stewards noted the explanation provided by Jockey Kingscote and advised him that, wherever possible, he should ensure that he fully tests his mounts to obtain the best possible placing in the field.

Y L Chung stated that his mount enjoyed a comfortable run during the race but responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
